BUILD WITH ME · FOUNDING SERIES

I’m glad you’re building with me.

We’ll build a digital presence that reflects your expertise and ambition, with the skills to keep making it your own.

Stripe will email your receipt once your payment succeeds. Keep it for your records; if your payment is still processing, wait for that confirmation.

Before we build

Prework before we begin

I’ll email your preparation guide and walk through it with you at our December 10 working kickoff. You’ll get a thorough checklist, inspiration, and guidance on the accounts, copy, images, and work samples to pull together. We’ll use December to prepare for the build.

Thursdays at 1 p.m. ET

Our working kickoff is December 10, 2026. Weekly building sessions begin January 7, 2027, on Thursdays at 1 p.m. ET (10 a.m. PT / 6 p.m. UK). Working sessions last 60–90 minutes. I’ll share the remaining dates before kickoff and confirm flexible office-hour times with the group.

Your individual time

Your place includes a bookable 30-minute session with me. If you added VIP, you’ll also have a separate 60-minute review. I’ll follow up with booking details.

What are you hoping to build?

Email me your current website, if you have one, and what you want your next one to do for you. You can also ask questions about the series or share a buddy referral.

Email Ariba Jahan

For payment questions, include the email address you used at checkout.
